BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE hybrid_planning_state_inbox, hybrid_evaluation_work, hybrid_evaluation_job IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_planning_state_inbox) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_evaluation_work) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_evaluation_job) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'refusing rollback: durable hybrid planning receipts/work/jobs must be preserved';
 END IF;
END $$;
DROP TABLE hybrid_evaluation_job;
DROP TABLE hybrid_evaluation_work;
DROP TABLE hybrid_planning_state_inbox;
DROP FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable();
COMMIT;
